full-screen takeover.about: the words fill the whole screen, top to bottom

spotlight.about: quick push in on your face with a small label

product moment.about: a snapshot of the product pops up with a pointer

big reveal.about: a sparkle, then the words take over

quiet.about: just you talking, nothing on top

scrapbook orbit.about: polaroid prints with washi tape circling on a ring; the front one big and sharp — every setting adjustable

scrapbook page.about: polaroid prints drop onto a paper page one by one, with optional handwritten captions

scrapbook stack.about: polaroid prints land on top of each other like a pile of photos being dealt
